reasoning: This is Kubeflow Hub, formerly Model Registry. Its main deliverable is a long-running Go REST API server: 'model-registry proxy' uses a chi router, serves OpenAPI v1alpha3 endpoints, and is backed by MySQL/PostgreSQL through GORM and migrations. The product image (Dockerfile.konflux, odh-model-registry) exposes port 8080 and starts the proxy server. The repo also ships extra pieces: a catalog service (cmd/catalog.go), a CSI storage initializer, a UI (clients/ui), a Python client, and a small controller under cmd/controller. These all support the registry service. Deploying model registry instances in RHOAI is the job of the separate model-registry-operator, so this repo is best classified as a service.
